messages:
Miko: Kicking off Ozone POC thread. They sent the enterprise auth checklist and want concise answers for SAML/SCIM/RBAC, domain proof, and a Hosted vs Dedicated pricing note. Also security asked about IdP outage fallback. @Hannah @Rafael can you provide details?

Hannah: SCIM defaults: delta_window = 900s (15m). For Dedicated we can reduce to 300s; for short POCs we can temporarily enable 60s but will monitor load. Default rate_limit = 300 req/min/tenant; POC bump to 500 req/min is acceptable. Recommend using batch endpoint for seeding.

Rafael: RBAC/SAML: primary pattern is SAML attribute `roles` -> explicit mapping in console. SCIM groups can map to roles as well. We never auto-promote to org_admin. Delegated-admin is opt-in and emits extra audit events. Example mapping: `okta:Engineering -> eng_viewer`, `okta:Admin -> platform_admin`.

Tess: Domain verification methods: DNS TXT (recommended), HTTP ownership token, or signed SAML metadata. For email subdomains DNS TXT is preferred.

Miko: Security asked: if IdP is down, can users authenticate? Need a one-line for questionnaire.

Rafael: One-liner: "Optional email magic-link fallback is available when enabled; on Dedicated this requires outbound email and may be restricted by customer network policy."

infra-bot: Staging tenant deploy scheduled 2026-06-01T04:00:00Z for Ozone POC.

Hannah: Sample SCIM PATCH we use for QA: `PATCH /scim/v2/Users` body: `[ { "op": "replace", "path": "emails[0].value", "value": "jane@ozone.co" } ]`. Config snippet: `scim.delta_window_seconds=900; scim.rate_limit_per_min=300; scim.batch_enabled=true`.

Miko: Sales action items: collect expected total users, daily deltas, and group counts to size Dedicated quote. I'll compile answers into the questionnaire PDF and share. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
